summary: Military aircraft performing high energy manoeuvres near Weaverthorpe, surface to 5,000 ft, at speeds up to 450 knots.
text:
AIR EXER. 1 MIL ACFT WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN
SUPPORT OF GROUND TROOPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 540645N 0003222W
(WEAVERTHORPE). ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KNOTS IAS
AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC
Y007/2023 REFERS. OPS CTC ON CH 127.185 OR FREQ 277.350MHZ. FOR
INFO 07517 258611. AR-2026-10131/01.
